name: BC857BLT1G
title: BC856, BC857, BC858, BC859 (A, B, C gain groups): 30 V to 65 V, 100 mA PNP general-purpose transistors in SOT-23
summary: A family of small-signal PNP silicon transistors in the three-lead SOT-23 (TO-236, CASE 318, style 6) surface-mount case. The type number sets the voltage class (VCEO -65 V for BC856, -45 V for BC857, -30 V for BC858 and BC859) and the letter sets the DC current gain group at -2 mA: A 125 to 250, B 220 to 475, C 420 to 800. All carry 100 mA continuous and 200 mA peak collector current and dissipate 225 mW on an FR-5 board; the BC859 adds a 4 dB maximum noise figure. BC857BLT1G is the 45 V, B-group part on a 3000-piece reel, marked 3F.

notes: Parts with an S or NSV prefix are AEC-Q101 qualified and PPAP capable, for automotive and other uses with unique site and change-control requirements; each carries the same marking as the plain part of its group.
The top of the case carries the two-character device code, a date code M and a Pb-free dot; the dot may sit in either of two places, and the date code's orientation or overbar depends on the plant.
All parts are lead-free, halogen-free/BFR-free and RoHS compliant.

operation.text: The number after BC fixes the breakdown ratings: BC856 is a 65 V part (VCBO and V(BR)CES 80 V), BC857 a 45 V part (50 V), BC858 and BC859 30 V parts. The letter after it is the hFE group, graded at -2.0 mA and -5.0 V. The emitter-base rating is 5 V for every type. Only the BC859 is held to a 4 dB noise figure; the rest are held to 10 dB.
Figures 1 to 6 apply to BC857, BC858, BC859, SBC857 and NSVBC858; Figures 7 to 12 apply to BC856 and SBC856. Misprint: the top label of the Figure 4 coefficient scale reads 1.0 and should read 0.8.

The active-region limits rest on TJ(pk) = 150 °C. The collector current is held to 200 mA by the bonding wire, then falls with rising VCE along a thermal limit (one line for TA = 25 °C, one for TJ = 25 °C) and a second-breakdown limit (1 s and 3 ms lines). Each type stops at its own VCEO: 30 V for BC558 and BC559, 45 V for BC557, 65 V for BC556. Pulse lines hold up to 10% duty cycle as long as TJ(pk) stays at or below 150 °C, and TJ(pk) follows from the thermal response curve. Hot cases or ambients lower the thermal limit below the second-breakdown limit; a circuit's collector load line has to stay under the curve that applies.
Misprint: the type names BC556 to BC559 in Figure 14 should read BC856 to BC859.

The normalized transient thermal resistance r(t) is given for single pulses and for repeated pulse trains of duty cycle 0.05, 0.1, 0.2 and 0.5, read at the end of the pulse t1. The thermal response uses RθJC = 83.3 °C/W max and RθJA = 200 °C/W max.
Allowed dissipation falls linearly above 25 °C ambient: by 1.8 mW/°C from 225 mW on the FR-5 board (RθJA 556 °C/W), and by 2.4 mW/°C from 300 mW on alumina (RθJA 417 °C/W).

SOT-23 (TO-236), CASE 318 issue AU: body 2.90 x 1.30 x 1.00 mm nominal, 1.90 mm pitch between pins 1 and 2. Dimensions D and E leave out mold flash, protrusions and gate burrs. Maximum lead thickness counts the lead finish; minimum lead thickness is that of the base metal. Dimensions follow ASME Y14.5M, 2018, and millimetres are the controlling unit.
